description: Payment verification on Ethereum, Base, Arc or BNB Chain: did a transaction really pay an address, totals per token, whether a minimum was met, confirmations. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

to.description: address that should have been paid

name: payment_verify
